entities.name: Treaty between Ukraine and the Russian Federation on the Ukrainian-Russian State border

entities.summary: The Treaty on the Russian–Ukrainian border is a bilateral international treaty between the Russian Federation and Ukraine, which delineated the land border line between the two countries.
